status_or_notes: Observations returned for 2000 to 2023 only (24 observations, date range 2000-2023 in variable metadata). No values returned for 2024 or 2025. The variable name carries a 'Sex=Female' qualifier that the server did not explain; the series is labelled as the maternal mortality ratio for Nigeria. A parallel series, undata/unicef/MNCH_MMR.SEX--F (provenance undata/p/UNICEF, source UNDATA, provenance URL https://data.unicef.org/), returns the same values to two decimal places for 2000 to 2023, and the same 2000 to 2023 date range. Its values were rounded to two decimals in the response. Also present but not used: undata/undphdro/GII_mmr.SEX--F (UNDP GII maternal mortality ratio, not queried).
